description: Connect the same account again after it signed out, keeping its account_id: send `session`, or `identifier` and `password`. Free. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

identifier.description: The account's sign-in email or phone.

remember.description: Optional opt-in: keep the sign-in details encrypted for automatic re-login.

name: account_reconnect
title: Reconnect an Account
